description: Texture is the new power move. The Nyoni Indigo Jacquard Tailored Blazer takes the authority of a navy blazer and elevates it with a rich tonal jacquard micro-check weave that catches the light and holds the eye. Cut from Super 110s wool in a deep indigo navy, with a clean single-button silhouette and notch lapels, this blazer is built for the man who wants formal without predictable. Available sizes 36–58.

name: Nyoni Navy Linen Two Piece Suit
description: Formal authority in the fabric that summer demands. The Nyoni Notch Linen Two Piece Suit takes the most commanding color in formal dressing and delivers it in 100% linen — the natural fiber that breathes where wool cannot, in deep colors that carries the full authority of formal dressing through every warm-weather occasion that demands it. Notch lapel, 2-button stance, matched trousers. The navy suit for every occasion the heat creates.

name: Nyoni Citrus Notch Sport Blazer
description: Make the entrance they'll remember. The Nyoni Citrus Notch Sport Blazer is a warm, sun-drenched statement piece for the man who leads with personality. Woven in Super 110s wool with a textured basketweave surface and a vibrant burnt-orange citrus colorway, this two-button blazer brings resort-ready energy to any occasion — from rooftop events to destination weddings to summer garden parties. Light, breathable, unapologetically bold. Available sizes 36–48. 100 % WOOL SUPER 200'S FABRIC

name: Nyoni Blush Peak Sport Blazer
description: Soft in color. Anything but shy. The Nyoni Blush Peak Sport Blazer is the blazer that rewrites what pink can do in a man's wardrobe. Cut from Super 110s wool in a clean blush rose with a fine piqué texture, featuring a wide peak lapel construction and a relaxed two-button front with pearlescent buttons — this is a blazer built for grooms, garden parties, and every occasion that calls for color done right. Available sizes 38–44. 100 % WOOL SUPER 200 WOOL

name: Nyoni Coral Notch Sport Blazer
description: Sun-kissed and unapologetically sharp. The Nyoni Coral Notch Sport Blazer brings warm, vacation-season energy to the Nyoni Couture blazer collection — a vivid coral-salmon woven in Super 110s wool with a fine birdseye texture, featuring clean notch lapels and a tonal two-button closure that keeps the colorway clean and cohesive. Built for the man who dresses for the moment without forgetting the occasion. Available sizes 38–48. – 100% Wool – Super 200'S Fabric

name: Nyoni Mint Notch Sport Blazer
description: Fresh. Clean. Unforgettable. The Nyoni Mint Notch Sport Blazer is summer menswear at its most confident — a cool, pale mint green woven in Super 110s wool with a fine piqué texture, featuring a wide notch lapel, tonal two-button closure, and a tailored silhouette built for destination weddings, garden receptions, and anywhere the dress code calls for smart-casual with personality. Available sizes 38–48. – 100% Wool – Super 200'S Fabric

name: Nyoni Navy Chalk Stripe Peak DB Suit
description: The suit that wrote the language of power dressing — and hasn't stopped speaking it since. Super 110s–200s wool, wide peak lapels, 6×2 button stance, chalk running clean through jacket and matched trousers. The suit that means business before you open your mouth. Available sizes 36–48.

name: Nyoni Oxblood Peak DB Suit
